The '''2010–11 Northern Illinois Huskies men's basketball team''' represented [[Northern Illinois University]] in the college basketball season of [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2010–11]]. The team, led by head coached by [[Ricardo Patton]], were members of the [[Mid-American Conference]] and played their homes game at the [[Convocation Center (Northern Illinois University)|Convocation Center]] in [[DeKalb, Illinois]]. The Huskies lost to [[Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball|Bowling Green]] in the first round of the [[2011 MAC men's basketball tournament|2011 MAC tournament]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310670189|title=Bowling Green 74, N. Illinois 54|work=[[ESPN]]|date=March 8, 2011|access-date=February 10, 2024}}{{dead link|date=July 2024|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref>
